core.why: attacks reduce remaining basic ability cooldowns
armor pen for the late game

Tristana.line: vs Tristana: her bomb rewards repeated attacks on one target. Watch its stacks before extending a trade.

Draven.line: vs Draven: axe landing markers reveal where he wants to move; use that information when placing feathers.

Caitlyn.line: vs Caitlyn: her basic attacks have longer range. Avoid giving up health for a single minion.

Ezreal.line: vs Ezreal: minions can block his Q. Check the minion line before taking a trade.

Jinx.line: vs Jinx: rockets give her extra attack range. Feather placement matters more than chasing her.

Kai'Sa.line: vs Kai'Sa: isolation makes her Q more concentrated. Your nearby minions can share those missiles.

Lucian.line: vs Lucian: his passive adds attacks after abilities. A short dash forward can signal a burst trade.

Samira.line: vs Samira: her blade whirl blocks projectiles. Mercurial does not cancel her ultimate.

Ashe.line: vs Ashe: Cleanse can remove her arrow's stun; it does not prevent the arrow's damage.

Vayne.line: vs Vayne: her third Silver Bolts hit adds true damage. Avoid extending every trade to three hits.

Miss Fortune.line: vs Miss Fortune: watch for Q bounces from low-health minions. Featherstorm does not interrupt her ultimate.

Jhin.line: vs Jhin: his fourth shot is a guaranteed critical hit, followed by a reload. Watch his ammo indicator.

Zeri.line: vs Zeri: minions can block her Q shots. Keep your escape route clear of walls she can cross.

Smolder.line: vs Smolder: his passive scales with stacks, not just items. His level alone does not describe his damage.

Sivir.line: vs Sivir: her spell shield can block an ability. Account for it before relying on a feather root.

Aphelios.line: vs Aphelios: his visible weapons change what he can do. Gravitum adds a root threat.

notes: Legacy M0 fields (start, core, runes, spells) are retained for old probe scripts only. The Rust planner never uses them as build defaults.
The production base path, loadout and skill order come from aggregate evidence. Alternatives are discovered through item effects, not this pack's preferred slots.
Matchup notes describe visible mechanics, not predicted lane winners or enemy cooldowns.
